note: The two sets are nearly identical and share the same defective claims — truncated WC model strings (C454CUFG#0 / C454CUFG# instead of C454CUFG#01), shower-head model 52655 misbound to the location 'BATHROOM SHOWER', and SV/SH locations truncated to 'BATHROOM' — so those cancel out. Set A keeps the tag conditions needed to disambiguate the two BRIZO faucets (model BSP-L-65014LF-PC tagged F2, location KITCHEN tagged F1), which Set B drops. Set B's single advantage is binding the Delta manufacturer claim to SHOWER VALVE, where Set A uses the vague entity 'Shower' with a garbled quote. On balance A is slightly more faithful because it preserves two needed conditions against B's one better-named entity.
remarks: Text layer is badly garbled over the FINISH SCHEDULE block (fragments like 'QU', 'FIE', 'PR', 'DE', '33'), so finish-schedule claims cannot be verified from the text alone; the image is the only reliable source there. Both sets invent the labels 'option 1'/'option 2' for the two F10 PATIO SIDE TABLE (S/2) dimension rows — the page shows two rows of a set-of-two, not options. Both sets also carry the garbled quote 'DESCRIPTION: SHOWE MANUFACTURER: DELTA', which is not verbatim on the page (source reads SHOWER VALVE / SHOWER HEAD, both DELTA). The WC model on the page is C454CUFG#01; both sets emit two truncated variants of it, which is both a misread and a duplicate.
